description: Product search. Send a product query; returns up to 40 Google Shopping offers with title, merchant, price (text plus parsed amount and currency), delivery, rating and link. Use to compare prices or find where a product is sold. Not for stock levels or buying. Prices are as listed at search time and may change. Typical response 1 to 2 s. Failed calls are not charged. Costs $0.01 (USDC, x402).

country.description: Optional two-letter country code, lower case, such as us or gb.

language.description: Optional language code, lower case, such as en or pt-br.

query.description: The product, as typed into a shopping search.

name: quantagentshop_shopping_search
title: Shopping search
